subject: general
question: Which of the following states is known for Mando Festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mando Festival is celebrated in Goa.
 
• Mando Festival
 
 
• Mando, in the early nineteenth century, was a song written almost exclusively in the spirit of competition.
 
• It was a** poetic and musical expression** of a personal feeling or an allegorical description of a political or level episode.
 
• Its theme is usually of love - bitter and sweet passion which is in slow and deliberate motion and is well expressed through beautiful movements of words and dance.
 
• Young men and women dance to the beat of romantic tunes of Ghumot (mud percussion instrument) and violin.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__ **

__
 
• Sao Joao festival__ 

 __
 
• It is celebrated in Goa to pay tribute to St. John the Baptist.

 
 
• St. John was the relative of Mother Mary.
 
 
 
• It is held at the beginning of the monsoon, on June 24.
 
 
 
• Shigmo__
 __
 
• It is celebrated in Goa as one of the prominent festivals of the Konkani Hindu community.

 Important Facts
 
 

 Karnataka
 Kambala
 
 
 
• ​It is a festival essentially associated with the Buffalo race.
 
• It is an annual festival celebrated in the Southern District of Karnataka.
 
• The festival is celebrated between the month of March and November.
 
• The festival is dedicated to Hindu God Lord Kadri Manjunatha, who is the epitome of Lord Shiva.
 
 
 
 

 Karnataka
 Kailpodh
 
 
 
• It is also known as the festival of weapons and harvest. 
 
 
• Kail means Armory/weapon and Podh means festivals.
 
 
 
• It is celebrated by the Kodava community of Kodagu district, Karnataka.
 
• This festival is celebrated after Putthari the harvest festival.
 
• Kailpodh is celebrated in the month of September and marks the end of the sowing season.
 
 
 
 

 Gujarat
 Vautha Mela
 
 
 
• It is an animal trading festival in the Indian state of Gujarat.
 
• It is organized in November in a village called Vautha.
 
 
 
 

 Gujarat
 Rann Utsav
 
 
 
• It is a festival in Kutch, Gujarat. 
 
• It is a 3 month-long Carnival of Music, Dance, nature beauty of White Rann, and much more than that when visiting under the full Moon.
 
• The Rann festival proudly showcases the myriad arts and crafts of Gujarat, its folk songs and dance, and the Rann’s natural beauty. 
 
 
 
 

 Gujarat
 Madhavpur Mela
 
 
 
• It is celebrated in the memory of Lord Krishna and Rukmini.
 
• It is held every year in the first week of April.
 
• The annual fair is held a day after the Ram Navami festival.
 
 
 
 

 Maharashtra
 Gudi Padwa 
 
 
 
• It is observed on the first day of the month of Chaitra which is the first month in the Hindu calendar.
 
• Gudi Padwa celebrates the crowning of Lord Ram after his return to Ayodhya along with Sita and Lakshman after completing an exile of 14 years.
 
• The Gudi (flag) denotes Lord Ram’s victory over the demon king Ravana.
 
 
 
 

 Maharashtra
 Lavani 
 
 
 
• It is one of the most popular dances in Maharashtra.
